title: ConversationSettings
description: Talking with an inhabitant (B6 R13, A1342): limits of the exchange and how understanding and the relation to the player change by outcome. The core computes every change from these rules; the AI only proposes the answer (B2462). Values are placeholders until Marcel's word.

deadline_ms.description: Deadline of a conversation request for the AI service.

no_answer_after_hours.description: Game hours after which an unanswered sentence counts as no answer (calm hint, R16).

recent_lines_max.description: How many recent lines an inhabitant keeps and sends as context.

understanding_start.description: Understanding of the player at the start (gestures before words, D333).

fear_start.description: Fear of the player at the start.

refund_on_no_answer.description: Give the favour back when no answer comes (service off, timeout).

understanding.description: Change of understanding when an exchange ends this way (computed by the core, never taken from the answer, B2462).

affection.description: Change of affection towards the player.

trust.description: Change of trust towards the player.

respect.description: Change of respect (awe) towards the player.

fear.description: Change of fear of the player.
